summary: The Healer selects a blessed spinach tin with e, then m. JS refuses the unported eat.c start_tin() path at step 27. C opens it immediately, asks whether to eat it, and applies the spinach effect after y. Port the tin opening and consumption family with occupation state and the doeat caller.

source.branch: doeat() sees otmp->otyp == TIN after the food selection; the blessed tin takes start_tin() immediate-opening arm when rn2(2) returns zero, then consume_tin() takes SPINACH_TIN, prompts to eat, updates food conduct and strength, consumes the tin, and adjusts hunger.
callers: eat.c doeat() dispatches selected TIN to start_tin() and returns ECMD_TIME; js/eat.js doeat() currently throws UnsupportedEatError at this site.
eat.c use_tin_opener() also calls start_tin(); the port must wire that caller and the occupation callback opentin().
dependencies: Preserve svc.context.tin.tin/o_id/usedtime/reqtime as one C tin-opening state and set_occupation(opentin) callback timing.
consume_tin() uses return values from tin_variety() and costly_tin() and the spinach branch calls gainstr() and lesshungry(); port or wire their consumed results from C source.

Reachability evidence covers the blessed immediate-open spinach branch; other tin varieties and delayed opening require independent matching evidence or named blocked recipes before source completion.
